title: Supreme Court Remands Bannon Case for Further Consideration
description_short: The Supreme Court vacated the judgment under review in Bannon’s case and remanded it in light of a pending motion to dismiss the indictment.
description_medium: On April 6, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court granted Steve Bannon’s petition, vacated the D.C. Circuit judgment, and remanded the case for further consideration in light of a pending motion to dismiss the indictment. The docket records a remand; it does not say the indictment was dismissed or that the conviction was set aside.
description_long: On April 6, 2026, the Supreme Court granted Steve Bannon’s petition, vacated the judgment under review, and remanded the case for further consideration in light of a pending motion to dismiss the indictment. The Court’s docket identifies the lower court as the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit and records that its decision was dated May 10, 2024, with rehearing denied on May 27, 2025. The Supreme Court docket later records that judgment issued on May 8, 2026. These entries describe the case’s path through appellate review and its return for further consideration. They do not show that the district court granted the motion to dismiss, that the indictment was dismissed, or that Bannon’s conviction was overturned. The original entry also joined this criminal case to a separate civil presidential-records lawsuit and characterized the government’s actions as dismantling accountability. This narrower account records only the docketed Supreme Court action and leaves those other claims outside the supported copy.
